detail: Added test_ethical_wall_denial_overrides_an_otherwise_allowed_admin_decision to backend/tests/test_org_access_resolver.py. Found no single function composes org_access.resolve_access with the wall check (no contract route calls the resolver yet); the real composed integration point is app.contracts.access.user_can_access_contract, which checks user_is_walled before any allow branch. Test proves (a) resolve_access says allowed=True and is_org_admin=True for the user via a native grant, (b) a control assertion shows user_can_access_contract allows the same admin on an unwalled contract, and (c) user_can_access_contract denies the same user on a walled contract despite (a)/(b) -- via raw SQL inserts for the wall rows so the two existing static regression tests (no app.walls/app.authority import in org_access.py or this test file) remain intact and green. No production bug found: the wall check runs first, unconditionally, ahead of admin/owner bypass. pytest tests/test_org_access_resolver.py: 17 passed. ruff check tests/test_org_access_resolver.py --ignore EXE002: clean. Full suite: 303 passed, 6 skipped (was 302/6 before this addition -- net +1 test, nothing broken).
